title: Musk joins Trump and Putin’s new axis of evil, as Starlink grounds Ukraine’s medium-range drones (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,693)
lede: Ukrainian officers warn that Starlink’s sudden speed limits have grounded much of their drone fleet and weakened air defences, as massive Russian strikes leave millions facing blackouts.

title: EU risks funding Israeli firms which help develop NAZA-type violent tech
lede: Billions in EU research cash are already flowing to Israeli firms linked to drones, AI targeting and surveillance, raising questions over whether Europe is effectively bankrolling technologies used against Palestinian civilians.

title: Big managers draw blurred lines on nuclear weapons exclusions
lede: Uncertain definitions and data issues lead to potential breaches of managers' exclusions policies, report by Facing Finance finds.
